title: Prepayment Fee Schedule and Free Prepayment Allowance — Farm Real Estate Loans
content:
Each FarmLand product of Farm Real Estate Loans carries two prepayment terms.

**Prepayment fee schedule.** The prepayment fee is set by loan year, the loan year being counted from the closing date or the last conversion date. The fee percentage for a prepayment is that of the first schedule entry whose "through loan year" is at least the current loan year; there is no fee after the last entry; a product with an empty schedule never carries a fee.

**Free prepayment allowance.** Prepayments up to this percentage of the principal balance at the start of the loan year carry no fee.

## Schedule by product

| Product | Prepayment fee by loan year | Free prepayment allowance (% of start-of-year principal) |
|---|---|---|
| FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage | no schedule — never a fee | 100 |
| FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage | through loan year 1: 2.0 percent; through loan year 3: 1.0 percent; no fee from loan year 4 | 20 |
| FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage | through loan year 2: 3.0 percent; through loan year 4: 2.0 percent; through loan year 5: 1.0 percent; no fee from loan year 6 | 20 |
| FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage | through loan year 3: 3.0 percent; through loan year 7: 2.0 percent; through loan year 10: 1.0 percent; no fee from loan year 11 | 20 |
| FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | through loan year 5: 3.0 percent; through loan year 10: 2.0 percent; through loan year 15: 1.0 percent; no fee from loan year 16 | 15 |
| FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | through loan year 5: 4.0 percent; through loan year 10: 3.0 percent; through loan year 15: 2.0 percent; through loan year 25: 1.0 percent; no fee from loan year 26 | 10 |

## Looking up a loan year (derived from the schedule)

| Product | Loan year | First entry whose "through" year is at least that year | Fee percentage |
|---|---|---|---|
| FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 1 | through 1 | 2.0 |
| FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 2 | through 3 | 1.0 |
| FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 5 | through 5 | 1.0 |
| FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 6 | none | no fee |
| FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 4 | through 7 | 2.0 |
| FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | 16 | through 25 | 1.0 |

On the FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage the free allowance is 100 percent of the start-of-year principal and the schedule is empty, so no prepayment there ever carries a fee.
